population__sex_all__age_0_4__variant_es.titleLong: Number of children under 5 - UN WPP
population__sex_all__age_0_4__variant_es.descriptionShort: The total population, measured on 1 July of the year shown. This only includes people aged 0-4.
population__sex_all__age_0_4__variant_es.descriptionProcessing: The UN publishes population by single year of age. We aggregate these into the broader age groups shown here (e.g. 0–14, 15–64, 65+, 18+, 15–49). Our continental aggregates (Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, Oceania) are computed by summing across countries, and may differ slightly from regional aggregates the UN publishes directly, which use a different country grouping.
